overview: Implement top-priority gameplay depth systems synthesized from Dwarf Fortress hydrodynamics, colonist strange moods, and subterranean acoustic geophone warning grids.

tasks.title: Multi-Z Magma & Groundwater Hydrodynamic Simulation (Dwarf Fortress Physics)
tasks.architectural_spec: Zero-heap 64x64x3 cellular automaton fluid solver tracking pressure, viscosity, and thermal transfer across Z-levels. Water meeting magma triggers an exothermic reaction depositing solid obsidian blocks; hydrostatic head pressure above 3.5 bar damages non-reinforced airlocks.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Fluid volume is strictly conserved; water-magma boundary generates solid obsidian; high hydrostatic pressure busts non-reinforced doors; zero heap allocation during fluid tick.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Dwarf Fortress-grade catastrophic tension when mining near subterranean aquifers or lava pockets, forcing quick emergency bulkhead closures or magma-channeling traps.

tasks.title: Colonist Strange Moods & Masterwork Relic Forging (DF / RimWorld Hybrid)
tasks.architectural_spec: Colonists undergo rare psychiatric inspiration ('Fey', 'Secretive', or 'Possessed'). The colonist claims a crafting workshop, gathers esoteric materials (obsidian, crystal pine, titanium rebar), and enters an unstoppable crafting trance. Success produces a Masterwork Relic with procedurally generated historical engravings providing +15 Colony Mood aura; failure results in melancholy or berserk breakdown.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Trigger rate scales with colonist skill and room impressiveness; colonist locks out other workers from workbench; completed artifact generates permanent immutable history description; zero heap allocation.
tasks.player_fun_impact: The ultimate Dwarf Fortress dopamine loop: scrambling to find rare minerals demanded by an inspired artisan before their timer expires, yielding legendary relics that commemorate colony milestones.

tasks.title: Subterranean Acoustic Geophone Grid & Overburden Seismic Warning
tasks.architectural_spec: Geophone acoustic sensor components installed along cavern walls measure micro-seismic vibrations and rock strain before roof failure. When overburden stress exceeds 85%, geophones emit audible acoustic clicks and pulsing amber HUD ripples 400 ticks before collapse, giving pawns a tangible evacuation window.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Sensor detects stress within 16-tile spherical radius; dispatches UI acoustic ripple alert to ColonyMap HUD before collapse occurs; triangulates epicenter across 3+ sensors; zero heap allocation.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Replaces sudden unfair cave-in deaths with visceral sensory dread and actionable triage: hearing the ominous creaking of rock in the darkness and seeing the HUD geophone pulse, giving players a thrilling 10-second countdown to pull miners out or rush support pillars in.
